map.为什么欧几里得算法一定收敛？: Why does the Euclidean algorithm always converge?
map.每步余数严格小于除数（a mod b < b），余数序列严格递减且非负，必在有限: Each remainder is strictly smaller than the divisor (a mod b < b), so the remainder sequence is strictly decreasing and non-negative and must reach 0 in finitely many steps.
